notes.title: Ever wondered how your loot is calculated 🏆 in Sky Clash?
notes.content:
Three star ⭐⭐⭐ attack is essential. The difference between the enemies’ 
levels of Town Halls also matters. Mind the following: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/630140]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29826710/688e186ba2aa039bde4dfcf357128949f5eccf1e.jpg[/img]
[/url]

1️⃣️ An attacked Admiral never loses 💯 of his property.
2️⃣️ An attacker only bites off 🍕 a part of it, even if the base is destroyed.
For instance, a raid against a player with:
↔️ Equal Town Hall level => brings a part of resources. 
↗️ Higher Town Hall level => has higher reward %
↘️ Lower Town Hall level => has lower reward %

Check it out now➡️:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/630140/Sky_Clash_Lords_of_Clans_3D/

notes.title: Use Revenge every now and then to earn resources easily!
notes.content:
Admirals found 5 strong reasons to avenge yourself often.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/630140]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29826710/85cfb5bcfd9ff8c32922cbf293f17886cf2cd7e6.jpg[/img]
[/url]  


Use Revenge every now and then to earn resources easily! Like this post 💟 if you agree that offenders must get the revenge! 😉

Reason 1 : Inspect the enemy base!
You can plan an ideal attack, because you are not limited on time to inspect the enemy base.
Things to find out:
✅ Range of defenses.
✅ Distribution of resources (check the «Info» of the production buildings and storages).
The Defense Log contains the info on the recent attacks at your base. Just tap an attacker’s nickname and then «Visit» to navigate to his base.

Reason 2: Get Loot bonus!​
Loot bonus 💰 is credited for revenge just like for any other battle, and depends on your league.

Reason 3️: Attack free!
Avengers pay nothing to find an opponent. And it’s always a good match! 

Reason 4️: Act fast!
The Defence Log keeps record of 15 attackers only, so never put off your revenge till tomorrow.

Reason 5️: Expect no payback!
If you take vengeance on a player, he won’t have a chance to requite. 

Check it out now; perhaps, there is a base worth attacking on your offenders list! 😏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/630140/Sky_Clash_Lords_of_Clans_3D/
